recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed in FHIR core for FHIR-13219 unless a future terminology policy issue changes how LOINC properties are represented.
issue_request: FHIR-13219 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocab correction for the FHIR-core CodeSystem artifact. It reported that the LOINC properties table at loinc.html#props listed ORDER_OBS twice, including one row whose description was "??", and requested removal of the bad duplicate row.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 9b4813c88eb5206932c3762b75d62d43091ca481, matching Jira's svn revision 12753 comment. That commit deleted the duplicate ORDER_OBS HTML table row with the "??" description from source/loinc.html.
additional_context: The old source/loinc.html page was removed later by FHIR-35933 in commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4. The current source instead has the LOINC CodeSystem definition in source/codesystem/loinc.xml, and the active CodeSystem resource is assigned to the vocab work group in source/fhir.ini. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later FHIR-core decision that reintroduced or contradicted the FHIR-13219 correction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/codesystem/loinc.xml contains exactly one ORDER_OBS property, with the substantive description, and has no ORDER_OBS property row whose description is "??".

related_jiras.note: Deleted the obsolete source/loinc.html page, so the current reconciliation checks source/codesystem/loinc.xml rather than editing the removed HTML page.
